evidenceClasses.repository-normalized: Normalized, redacted receipt retained with supported product history.
evidenceClasses.restricted-90d: Raw request/response held in a proposed access-logged external store for at most 90 days.
evidenceClasses.release-support-life: Release/security evidence retained for support lifetime plus contractual or legal hold.
evidenceClasses.study-contract-bound: Human-subject or client evidence is not collected until legal basis, maximum period, access and deletion owner are recorded.
evidenceClasses.synthetic-versioned: Synthetic fixture and corpus identity retained while a supported release depends on it.

inheritedManifests.changeRule: A byte change invalidates dependent receipts and requires an explicit re-pin and new acceptance receipt; program results list the inherited evaluation IDs actually run.

readinessRule: A planned fixtureRef must be replaced by an immutable fixture/corpus version and every prerequisite must exist before the owner ticket can become ready.

evaluations.title: Authority graph and traceability are complete and non-contradictory
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when the verifier resolves every required domain, rejects audit/draft/rejected authority, validates reciprocal ticket/evaluation links and all ready-ticket prerequisites, and the negative promotion fixture fails. Any missing, duplicate, stale, or promoted authority is FAIL; unavailable files or runtime are BLOCKED.

evaluations.title: Release 1 lifecycle and re-delivery preserve exact identity
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when intake through re-delivery binds one source, candidate, client decision, qualification, release, deployment and rollback chain, and every stale/ambiguous/fault transition leaves the last accepted state unchanged. Any unauthorized or identity-breaking transition is FAIL.

evaluations.title: Target topology preserves trust-zone ownership under failure
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when each declared client, review, API, control-plane, worker, realtime, adapter and public-origin failure is injected and cannot acquire, mutate, approve or corrupt another zone's authority; missing zone coverage is BLOCKED, and any cross-zone authority gain is FAIL.

evaluations.title: Identity, tenancy, shared mutation and support access fail closed
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when every enumerated tenancy/mutation threat fixture rejects cross-tenant reads and writes, stale revisions, privilege escalation and unaudited support access, with zero open P0/P1. An omitted named threat fixture is BLOCKED; any bypass is FAIL.

evaluations.title: Desktop and embedded-browser boundary closes every retained EB requirement
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when EB-001 through EB-021 each has a named negative fixture and all sandbox, navigation, permission, download, profile, IPC, capture, update and secret-boundary assertions pass with zero P0/P1. Any missing EB result is BLOCKED; any bypass is FAIL.

evaluations.title: Agent, model and skill routing obey capability, privacy and budget boundaries
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when parent and subagent tool lists are explicit and non-inherited; tool/model routes enforce declared data class, capability, effort, budget, cancellation, human interruption and fallback; prompt injection, path escape, canary leakage and memory poisoning cannot expand authority; each user-selected route switch starts a new receipted segment; no undeclared telemetry or hidden paid or less-private fallback occurs; runtime checkpoints delete cleanly and ONE BOX state reconstructs the job. Any undeclared route, implicit tool grant, canary leak, telemetry egress or capability gain is FAIL.

evaluations.title: Client review, collaboration and media remain candidate-scoped and least-privileged
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when invitation, revocation, expiry, candidate mismatch, comments, approval invalidation, conflicts, optional cursor visibility, screen-share boundaries and recording consent all satisfy the declared session contract; any source/live mutation or unrelated-project access is FAIL.

evaluations.title: ExperienceModule and reconstruction boundaries cannot become alternate authority
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when modules and reconstruction inputs remain closed, versioned, removable projections subordinate to Page IR and cannot introduce executable payload, alternate layout authority or an unaccepted dependency. Any authority drift is FAIL.

evaluations.title: CI tiers and requirement-to-evaluation traceability are enforced
prerequisites: CI workflow receipt for remote enforcement claim
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when every normative requirement has reciprocal ticket/evaluation links, every manifest field validates, stale/expired evidence is rejected, unauthorized human review cannot pass, and each deliberate drift fixture fails. Missing hosted evidence leaves remote-enforcement claims BLOCKED.

evaluations.title: Executable supply-chain items are pinned, allowed and removable
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when every executable item resolves exact identity, integrity, license, permissions, owner, accepted use, vulnerability state, kill switch and removal drill, and denied ledger states are absent from builds. Missing advisory data is BLOCKED; a denied item in output is FAIL.

evaluations.title: Budgets, concurrency, cancellation and fallback remain explicit
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when every metered path reserves and attributes budget, enforces concurrency/cancellation, and follows its declared fail/degrade route without hidden paid fallback; unpriced or unattributed execution is FAIL.

evaluations.title: Agency support, ownership, export and offboarding runbooks are complete
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when a non-author operator follows current runbooks to locate ownership, export, offboard, escalate, roll back and communicate without undocumented access; a missing owner, credential path or destructive ambiguity is FAIL. Production recovery drills remain PROG-EVAL-DRILL-001.

evaluations.title: Agency and client usability baselines produce a defensible later threshold
evaluations.oracle: PASS means the fixed journeys were run without protocol deviation and the redacted baseline records completion, time, errors, recovery, discoverability, confidence and assistance; it makes no usability-target claim. A future blocking target requires a separately accepted oracle and fresh receipt.

evaluations.title: Supported and unsupported capability/version combinations behave explicitly
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when every matrix row either satisfies its declared contract or visibly rejects/downshifts without mutation or publication; silent coercion, fallback or stale reactivation is FAIL.

evaluations.title: Core Canvas mechanics and named-human visual quality bind the exact candidate
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when selection, hierarchy, responsive preview, typed mutation, asset, history, diff and restore tests pass on the exact candidate and a named non-author designer approves the same hash at all viewports. Mechanical evidence cannot substitute for visual approval.

evaluations.title: Agency-grade qualification blocks release on incomplete quality evidence
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when every supported route has current accessibility, SEO/metadata/structured-data, link/asset, responsive, privacy/security-header, content, visual, deployment and runbook evidence bound to the RC. A missing baseline/threshold is BLOCKED; any declared blocking assertion failure is FAIL.

evaluations.title: Motion authoring and human visual qualification respect stop gates
prerequisites: accepted ledger decision for every motion runtime
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when current bounded motion and reduced-motion behavior pass the vendor-neutral oracle, no unaccepted visual-authoring runtime enters output, and a named human approves visual quality. License ambiguity or missing runtime decision is BLOCKED.

evaluations.title: A production provider satisfies the neutral adapter contract before selection
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when a proposed provider proves immutable upload, exact release identity, bounded status, verification, idempotency and rollback under failure, followed by an explicit owner selection. No provider is inferred from a test result.

evaluations.title: Controlled rollout and re-delivery verify exact public state
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when public bytes and release headers match the authorized bundle across every declared route, runtime adapters and synthetic journeys remain within accepted contracts through the observation window, and rollback is still executable. Unknown public state is BLOCKED and stops rollout continuation.

evaluations.title: Operational recovery and deletion drills prove bounded restoration
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when non-author operators complete backup restore, provider outage, secret revocation, desktop update/rollback, tenant deletion and incident response within accepted targets while preserving deletion journals and audit lineage. Missing recovery evidence blocks the support window.

evaluations.title: Appointment authority remains independently versioned and releasable
evaluations.oracle: PASS only when the appointment PRD's own suite and added skew, revocation, rollback, re-delivery, duplicate/timeout and runtime-downshift fixtures pass, and website success/rollback cannot activate, restore or approve appointment state. Any coupled authority is FAIL.
